title: Postdoctoral Positions, NCTS Math Division (2027)
institution: National Center for Theoretical Sciences (NCTS), Math Division
about: Taiwan's National Center for Theoretical Sciences Math Division is recruiting postdocs in all fields of mathematics. Fall appointments start from 1 August 2027. Fall applications are due 28 February 2027.

upskill.name: Data Analytics Academy
why: No course reached the minimum match score for this all-fields mathematics postdoc; the closest Academy page is Data Analytics, which hosts A005.01 Statistical & Mathematical Foundations I: "Mathematics (all fields)" → "Introduce Bayesian statistics and probabilistic modelling as approaches for representing uncertainty and updating analytical conclusions as new evidence becomes available."
